title: I made a little town in three.js where you can drift around and do deliveries
author: Designer-Rain8165
selftext:
All this came from two prompts. I saw someone make a 3D sword with Nex-N2.6, so I hooked up the API in OpenCode and gave the model a little driving game to stress-test. Might make a series out of these.

1st prompt got me a town with traffic and a day/night cycle. For the 2nd I asked for a better car model, tire smoke, pedestrians and a delivery job. Hit M and you get a pickup, a drop-off and a countdown.

Setup: OpenCode with Nex-N2.6 via the MOSS API

Model: Nex-N2.6, a multimodal agent model built on GLM-5.3-Flash

Stack: three.js r170, plain ES modules, no build step

I gave it a little headless Chrome script so it could look at screenshots of its own day and night views. When the three.js CDN timed out twice, Nex-N2.6 copied three.js into the project and pointed the import map at the local file on its own.

Both runs came to about 6.6M tokens, mostly cached reads. Worked out to around 20 cents total, which is pretty cheap for a whole little driving game.
